name: Black Cat Affogato
flavor_notes: Classic affogato character — intensely flavored hot coffee poured fast over cold vanilla gelato.

review.verdict: Simple perfection. High-fat vanilla bean gelato melts into a luxurious custard under the hot espresso extraction.

channel_verdicts.cometeer: Melt puck with 2 oz boiling water; the high extraction yield blankets the cold gelato without turning it watery.
channel_verdicts.nespresso: Vertuo single Diavolitto or Il Caffè creates the ideal hot crema crown.
channel_verdicts.instant: Use a super-concentrated bloom (1.5 tsp Medaglia d'Oro in just 1.5 oz boiling water) so the gelato doesn't melt too fast.

preparations.roast_note: Needs a bold, intense coffee to read through the cold gelato — a lighter roast gets lost.

ingredients.item: Cometeer Decaf Black Cat Espresso, melted

steps: Stir the boiling water into the melted coffee.
Place the gelato in a small serving bowl or glass.
Pour the hot coffee over the gelato.

ingredients.item: Nespresso Vertuo pod, brewed as a single shot
ingredients.notes: Decaf Diavolitto or Il Caffè recommended

steps: Scoop cold gelato into a chilled serving glass or bowl.
Brew the Nespresso pod directly as a single espresso shot into a heatproof glass.
Pour the hot espresso immediately over the gelato.
Top with shaved dark chocolate if desired and serve at once.

ingredients.notes: dark roast or instant espresso powder

steps: Dissolve the instant coffee in boiling water to produce a rich, dark coffee concentrate.
Place two scoops of cold gelato in a serving bowl.
Pour the hot coffee concentrate directly over the gelato.
Finish with shaved dark chocolate and enjoy immediately.
